bio.heading: From the first frame to the final cut.
bio.paragraph1: Esteban is a South-Florida-based visual storyteller working across aerial cinematography, portrait and event photography, brand-film videography, and post-production. He directs the shoot and finishes the edit, so the look, pacing, and feel stay coherent end to end.
bio.paragraph2: Most clients come in asking for one piece — a drone reveal, a brand film, a campaign portrait set — and end up working with him across formats because the through-line stays consistent. Bilingual direction (EN/ES) on set keeps talent comfortable and the day moving.
bio.paragraph3: Off-set, he is a relentless image-nerd: studying color, watching films frame by frame, and rebuilding shots in the edit until they feel inevitable. The goal is never the gear — it's the feeling on the other side of the screen.

brand.heading: We make things feel like a film.
brand.body: Cinematic, calm, confident. No corporate jargon, no superlatives without proof. Story-first directing on the day, story-first cutting in the edit. One studio, one pair of hands — capture and post under the same roof.
